title: Four evidence files
html:
The museum sent four files.

Exhibit PDU/01evidence-01.zipstaff.csv, incident_report.txt, cameras.xml, floorplan.pngDownload

Start with incident_report.txt. The guard who found the empty easel wrote down what he saw. It is the only description of the evening you get.

Then use the other files to answer the questions.

fields.label: How many employees are listed in staff.csv?
fields.help: Open staff.csv with the tool you prefer, or with VS Code. <button type="button" class="how" data-howto="vscode">How to: open a file in VS Code</button>

fields.label: Through which room does the guard think the painting left? Give its code on floorplan.png. For example, the code of the Salle des Etats is G4.
According to cameras.xml, which camera hangs in that room? Give its ID.
fields.help: <button type="button" class="how" data-howto="xml">How to: read XML</button>

hints: In staff.csv every line is one employee, except one line. For the room: the guard writes his guess under the heading WHAT I NOTICED in incident_report.txt. Then find that room on floorplan.png.

The first line of staff.csv holds the names of the columns, so count the lines and take one off: VS Code shows line numbers. The guard names the service corridor. On floorplan.png its code is the two letters in that room. In cameras.xml, look for the camera with that zone.
